notes: All 6 required web searches ran this time, plus 1 more on Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act cosponsors (7 in total). The site-restricted search found only scam, China-technology and energy releases; the five topic searches (superintelligence, extinction or existential risk, pause or slowdown, China agreement, "AI safety") returned nothing mentioning him. An earlier run also opened his official press release listing pages 1 to 4 (late 2025 to 16 October 2026) and the 1 October 2026 scam call machine bill release; none mention AI risk. Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538, Casar, September 2026): no source shows him as a cosponsor; reports describe the cosponsors as about nine House Democrats, but the congress.gov cosponsor page returned 403 so the full list was not checked directly. A 27 June 2025 letter he signed to Secretary Rubio on Southeast Asian scam centers mentions AI-enabled calls (seen in search summaries, not opened; scam-related, so D at most, left out). Related bills (BIS STRENGTH Act, 9 January 2026; Securing Federal Devices from Chinese Applications Act, 16 January 2026; Protecting Domestic Mining Act of 2025, which mentions AI projects under permitting) are not about AI risk. Not checked: hearing remarks and floor speeches beyond what searches surfaced.
